{{greeting}}

Thanks for giving bingd a shot!

The app was inspired by my experience using Beli, which changed the way
I enjoyed restaurants. I went from someone who liked occasionally eating
out to someone who ranked every restaurant, compared lists with friends,
and actively looked for the next place to try.

I built bingd because I think movies and TV are missing that same loop,
one that can make the post-watch ritual almost as exciting as the watch
itself. See where your latest movie lands in your rankings, comment on
and save your friends' latest TV shows, and get stronger recommendations
with a better rating system.

If you have feature suggestions, something in the app is confusing, or
you just want to say hi, reply to this email. It comes straight to me.

bingd is more fun with friends, so here's your invite link
(https://bingd.app/i/{{inviteToken}}). And if you want to see what I'm
watching, follow me on bingd (https://bingd.app/u/saisurajkan).

Happy binging,
Suraj
